title: Tarihin En Başarılı Başarısızlığı
visualStyle: Authentic 1970 NASA archival photograph, Ektachrome film grain, hard mission lighting, documentary realism.

imagePrompts: Extreme close-up of an analog oxygen pressure gauge in a 1970 spacecraft, the needle falling toward zero
Close-up of a 1970 mission control console, rows of blinking indicator lights and toggle switches
Extreme close-up of an astronaut's gloved hand on a metal toggle switch, breath fogging in the cold cabin
The Earth small and blue through a tiny triangular spacecraft window, deep black space around it
Engineers' hands emptying a cardboard box of spare hoses, tape and plastic bags onto a table under fluorescent light
A tiny spacecraft silhouette drifting in front of the grey cratered Moon, total darkness
scenes.say: [whispers] Oksijen bitiyor... Ay çok uzakta... [dramatic] ve dönüş yok.

scenes.title: Başarılı Başarısızlık
scenes.imagePrompt: A Saturn V rocket lifting off from the launch pad in 1970, huge plume of fire and smoke, dawn sky
scenes.sound: distant rocket rumble, crowd murmur far away, wind
scenes.say: [curious] Bu... tarihin en başarılı başarısızlığının hikâyesi.

scenes.label: Dünya'dan uzaklık
scenes.say: [confident] Dünyadan dört yüz bin kilometre uzakta...

scenes.search: Apollo 13 crew portrait Lovell Swigert Haise
scenes.imagePrompt: Official 1970 portrait of three astronauts in white spacesuits standing together
scenes.name: Lovell · Swigert · Haise
scenes.say: [warmly] Üç astronot: Jim Lovell, Jack Swigert ve Fred Haise.

scenes.imagePrompt: A white Saturn V rocket climbing into a blue sky trailing flame, seen from far away
scenes.say: [curious] On bir Nisan bin dokuz yüz yetmiş... hedef Ay'a inmekti.

scenes.imagePrompt: Inside a cramped 1970 spacecraft cabin, an astronaut in a white jumpsuit reaching up to flip a switch on a crowded instrument panel, dim instrument light
scenes.sound: quiet spacecraft cabin hum, fans whirring, a switch click
scenes.say: [quietly] Elli beşinci saatte... rutin bir düğmeye basıldı.

scenes.imagePrompt: A damaged spacecraft service module drifting in space, one side panel blown away, torn metal and wires exposed
Flight controllers in white shirts leaning over consoles in a 1970 mission control room, tense faces
scenes.sound: radio static, low murmur of voices in a control room

scenes.imagePrompt: A flight director in a white vest standing at a mission control console in 1970, looking at screens
scenes.name: Gene Kranz
scenes.sound: busy control room, phones, radio chatter
scenes.say: [serious] Uçuş direktörü Gene Kranz ekibine tek bir şey söyledi: sakin kalın.

scenes.imagePrompt: A lunar module spacecraft with gold foil and spindly legs floating in black space
scenes.caption: Aquarius: cankurtaran sandalı
scenes.sound: deep space hum, faint radio beeps
scenes.say: [curious] Plan cüretkârdı: Ay modülü... cankurtaran sandalı olacaktı.

scenes.imagePrompt: A makeshift square air filter box built from cardboard, plastic bags and grey duct tape, taped to a hose inside a spacecraft
scenes.caption: Bant, karton ve plastik torba
scenes.sound: tape being torn, plastic rustling, quiet cabin hum
scenes.say: [warmly] Yerdeki mühendisler... kutu, bant ve torbadan bir hava filtresi uydurdu.

scenes.text: Tek bir hata ve kapsül atmosferde yanacaktı
scenes.imagePrompt: A small cone-shaped capsule glowing orange hot as it plunges into Earth's atmosphere, a trail of plasma behind it
scenes.say: [serious] Tek bir hata... ve kapsül atmosferde yanacaktı.

scenes.imagePrompt: Flight controllers standing silently at their consoles, staring at a big screen, 1970 mission control
scenes.caption: Dört dakika sessizlik
scenes.sound: tense silence, faint radio static hiss

scenes.caption: Üçü de sağ salim

scenes.say: [warmly] Üç astronot da sağ salim eve döndü.
